items.title: Product showcase: iVerify Basic helps users check device security and improve privacy
items.summary: iVerify Basic is a mobile security app for individuals who want to check their devices for signs of compromise and improve their security settings. It is available for iOS and Android, including tablets. Device security checks The Device tab puts scan controls and security status on one screen.

items.title: People are still using weak passwords despite advice to use stronger ones, says NordPass
items.summary: A new study by NordPass found that people still prefer using weak passwords because they are easier to remember, even at the expense of their online security.

items.title: Fraudsters feed the right face into identity checks through virtual cameras
items.summary: Document fraud remains the largest attack category in Entrust’s The Professionalization of Fraud: 2027 Identity Fraud Report, with criminals combining physical counterfeits, digital manipulation and impersonation to target online services. The document fraud rate fell 19% year over year.

items.title: Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938): Frequently asked questions about OpenJDK remote code execution vulnerability
items.summary: Java4Shell is a flaw in how Java decodes Base64 data. Calif, which found it, says it can let attackers run code on widely used Java applications without logging in. Oracle released fixed Java builds on November 17, and Calif is withholding its exploits for individual applications for now.

items.title: Announcing Hardened Server Core for Windows Server Insiders
items.summary: For years, Windows Server shipped compatible by default. Making the server secure was up to you, usually by applying the Security Baseline or your own hardening scripts after setup. Until that work was done, every new server ran in a less secure state, and that gap was easy to miss.

items.title: Windows Server 2028: A trusted foundation for an evolving enterprise
items.summary: Enterprise infrastructure has evolved in response to changing and increasing business demands. Windows Server helped connect the enterprise by bringing people and resources together with Active Directory. As more business processes moved into software, it became a place to run business-critical applications.

items.title: From 5 Teams to More Than 100: How a Pharma Field Organization Scaled Agility
items.summary: A field organization started with five cross-functional pilot teams. A few years later it had more than a hundred, and each therapeutic area had found its own way of working. It didn't scale because of a master plan or deployment roadmap. It scaled because each phase delivered new information about what works.
